parsed.notes: Maximum Consolidated Leverage Ratio of 3.75x steps up to 4.25x upon a Qualified Acquisition; leverage uses gross debt (not netted against cash). The 3.75x limit at 2025-12-31 is assumed, since the agreement was in effect then. The 3.00x pro forma leverage test applies to incremental borrowings, and the 3.50x level is a restricted-payments threshold; neither is a maintenance covenant, so both are excluded. Margin grid ratios are also excluded.
